summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 21, 2026, attaching an earnings release for its second quarter and first six months of 2026. The report details financial and operational results, including a 15.4% revenue increase and a 34.3% EBITDA rise, with management commentary on performance. This is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16, not a special-situation event. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is disclosed.
